reading_note: The teaching reveals that the many "names of the garments" are all designations for one and the same divine truth-and-good (the soul, the light) clothed in successive external forms as it descends through the discrete degrees, suffers within natural existence, is gathered by various spiritual operations, and finally returns to its first substance under one unchanging name. The arc moves: question (what do these names truly signify?) → answer that all are external clothings of the five interior degrees of the Divine Human → enumeration of how each name corresponds to a specific operation of redemption (the Pillar of Glory as body of return, Jesus as the awakening Power in stars and archons, the three garments as wind/fire/water established by the Living Spirit, the Cross as the bound Light suffering in the ground, the Counsel of Life as Calling and Hearing, the suffering soul as the truth-good in seeds crushed for the world's nourishment) → consummation: when all external figures are stripped away, the many names collapse into one name in the region of first substance whence the truth was sent against falsity.
